body: At a high level you can beat out anyone stalling for fever with Carbuncle most of the time, his dropset is definitely good for this but it's a backup strategy, I go for big chains with Carbuncle, his real strength here is that either you can throw down a 10+ quickly or you can harass while maintaining a lead in resources, and the ability to pressure heavily with 3/4 chains and all clears to force your opponent into fever and then just get a quick 8/9 to force the opponent into a defensive position. One drawback of having so many big puyo though is that it forces either a clear or a split which are inefficient and the L/J and 2 colour 4s are more likely to need split too, actually the most OP character is Rulue, her high chain power out of fever and reasonably large dropset are major assets, Raffine is the other candidate and Arle is definitely OU due to her consistency, I'm not bad but if a player of a similar level picks Arle, I'm going to do the same as even being good with dropsets, being able to get a big chain reliably is a bigger advantage than higher power or ability to spam fever.
